narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Shift -> Announcement -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional announcement for the 'Mom & Dad Storytelling' brand. It uses a casual 'vlog-style' office tour to build intimacy with the audience before announcing the launch of their new official website and an upcoming membership promotion. The core appeal lies in the friendly persona of '華爸' and the promise of housewarming gifts for users who log in.
